title: Factors controlling the performance of lithium-metal solid-state batteries with polyethylene oxide-based composite polymer electrolytes
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, 5,119-129
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00278H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bapi Bera, Douglas S. Aaron, Matthew M. Mench
The transference number is a critical parameter in solid-state batteries, as it determines how efficiently Li+ ions move through the electrolyte to reach the electrode interface. We measured the transference number using a symmetric coin cell.
